notes: After a restart, your DAC is ready right away, even when it comes up a few seconds after the computer. No need to choose it again.
When your DAC comes back after being off or unplugged, Limpid OS takes it again by itself.
A DAC that came up at a slow USB speed, though it can go faster, is reconnected by Limpid OS once, by itself, as unplugging it and plugging it back in would.
